雅思早间任务 · 第 6 周第 3 天（11 月 27 日 周五）

今天的主题：教育、考试成绩和科技对学习的影响。这是雅思 G 类大作文的高频话题：「学校该不该禁止学生用手机」「电脑能不能代替老师和课本」「年轻人的阅读能力是不是在下降」；听力和阅读里常出现 assessment、performance、average、decrease、significantly 这类描述成绩和趋势的词；口语 Part 1 也会问 Do you like reading? Did you enjoy your school days?。今天是第 6 周第 3 天，强化期继续，每个词后面 ≈ 是同义替换，背的时候连同义词一起记。

例句

  • The average reading score has decreased significantly over the past ten years.（过去十年，平均阅读分数显著下降。）
  • Many schools prohibit pupils from using mobile phones in class.（很多学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。）
  • Students' academic performance may deteriorate if they sleep too little.（学生睡得太少，学业成绩可能会变差。）
  • The results indicate that screen time affects concentration.（结果表明，屏幕时间会影响注意力。）
  • Computer skills should be part of the school curriculum; consequently, every pupil needs a tablet.（电脑技能应该纳入学校课程，因此每个学生都需要一台平板电脑。）

同义替换小抄（今天这集和雅思题最常见的考法）：

题目写 fell / decreased → 录音说 went down / dropped　|　题目写 a big fall → 录音说 a steep drop / a sharp decline　|　题目写 get worse → 录音说 deteriorate　|　题目写 test / exam → 录音说 assessment　|　题目写 ban completely → 录音说 put a blanket ban on / prohibit　|　题目写 an obvious problem nobody discusses → 录音说 the elephant in the room　|　题目写 students → 录音说 pupils / schoolchildren / 15-year-olds

过关标准：遮住中文看英文，能说出 22 个以上的意思，并能说出至少 15 个词的一个同义替换。再挑 5 个自己造句（试试用 prohibit、concentration、academic performance 写一句「学校该禁止手机」的理由，大作文能直接用）。

BBC 6 Minute English：Is Gen Z getting less intelligent?（Z 世代在变笨吗？），11 月 26 日昨天刚出的新一期。Phil 和 Georgie 聊国际 PISA 测试：从 2012 年起 15 岁学生的成绩一直在下降，原因可能是新冠停课，也可能是课堂上用电脑平板代替了课本；但新加坡学生课堂用科技最多，成绩却最好，所以「全面禁止」不一定有用。这集 6 分半钟，主持人语速适中，PISA 负责人 Andreas Schleicher 那段有德语口音、句子长，最难。音频和原文都已经放在页面里，不用打开 BBC 网站。节目后面照样有一组我按雅思格式出的题（选择 Q1–3 + 笔记填空 Q4–9）。

  1. 先把上面的听前生词过一遍，听不太懂可以先读懂原文再听。
  2. 第一遍不看文字，像考试一样做下面的 Q1–9，只听一遍，听完点「对答案」。注意数字：every three years、25 years ago、30 countries、2012、eight hours，听力里数字和年份经常是答案或定位词。
  3. 第二遍点开下面的原文精听，听不出的地方暂停、倒回去并标出来。Andreas 那段先读懂中文再听。
  4. 第三遍挑 Jade Bowler 那段（"Even if you were to just put a blanket ban on technology at schools..."）跟读，模仿语调和连读，这段话口语 Part 3 谈手机禁令时能直接借用。
  5. 记住 6 个表达：disruption（打乱）、the elephant in the room（明摆着却没人提的问题）、deteriorate（变差）、steep drop（大幅下降）、blanket ban（全面禁令）、scroll（没完没了地刷手机）。

Questions 1–9（按雅思格式自编）

Questions 1–3　Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

1 When they were at school, Phil and Georgie
A found exams very stressful.　B quite enjoyed taking exams.　C rarely had to take exams.

2 According to Phil, the average PISA scores of the 30 original countries
A have all fallen.　B have risen in maths only.　C have stayed about the same.

3 Why does Phil mention Singapore?
A Its students use less technology than anyone else.　B It suggests that screens may not be the cause of lower scores.　C Its reading scores have dropped the most.

Questions 4–9　Complete the notes below. Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

Falling PISA test scores

• 15-year-olds are tested once every 4 years in reading, maths and science

• Amy Orben: Covid led to school 5 and problems in families and society

• But scores have been lower since 6 , before Covid began

• In many schools, textbooks and notebooks were replaced by laptops and 7

• Andreas Schleicher: the biggest fall is in 8

• Jade Bowler: even with a ban at school, teenagers could go home and 9 for eight hours

答案：1 B　2 A　3 B　4 three（3）　5 closures　6 2012　7 tablets　8 reading　9 scroll。同义替换提示：题目 have all fallen = 录音 they're all going down；题目 the biggest fall = 录音 the steep drop；题目 were replaced by = 录音 replacing ... with；题目 screens may not be the cause = 录音 screens aren't the problem；题目 once every three years = 录音 every three years。第 1 题 A 是干扰项，Georgie 说的是 I actually quite enjoyed exams，Phil 说 Me too；第 3 题 C 容易误选，阅读大降是 Andreas 讲的整体情况，新加坡反而是各科成绩都很好、课堂上用科技也几乎最多。

If we were to see the same decline下降 in all subject areas, you might say, "Well, education is deteriorating恶化，变差," but that's not the case不是这样. 过关标准：Q1–9 答对 7 题以上；不看原文能用中文说出这集讲了什么（成绩从哪年开始降、两个可能的原因、为什么新加坡是反例）；Jade 那段能流利读下来。

小练习

  1. The strike caused serious ______ to train services across the country.（打乱，中断）
  2. His health ______ quickly after he stopped exercising.（变差）
  3. Last year there was a ______ ______ in the number of tourists.（大幅下降，两个词）
  4. The government has introduced a ______ ______ on smoking in all public places.（全面禁令，两个词）
  5. Candidates are ______ from using mobile phones during the exam.（禁止）
  6. Reading too many short posts may harm your ______.（专注力）
点开看答案

开头那题选 c，75 万（750,000），Georgie 猜 b 答错了。填空：1. disruption 2. deteriorated 3. steep drop 4. blanket ban 5. prohibited 6. concentration

今天的小思考（为口语 Part 1 / Part 3 做准备）：Do you think schools should ban mobile phones? 用英语说两三句：In my opinion, schools should / shouldn't ..., because ... / On the other hand, ...。Part 3 再想一层：Is technology making young people better or worse at learning?（可以用 concentration、academic performance、deteriorate、significantly、indicate）
